description: React component for the right-hand side channel members list in Mattermost, including UI for searching, inviting, and managing channel members.

methods.name: formatAttributeName
methods.description: Formats attribute names for tooltips by converting snake_case or camelCase to Title Case with spaces.

methods.name: setSearchTerms
methods.description: Sets the search terms for filtering channel members.

methods.name: doSearch
methods.description: Performs a debounced search for profiles and channel members based on search terms.

methods.name: inviteMembers
methods.description: Opens modal to invite members to the channel or start a direct message.

methods.name: openDirectMessage
methods.description: Opens a direct message channel with a user and navigates to it.

methods.name: loadMore
methods.description: Loads more channel members for pagination.
